title: US Department of State issued 23% fewer study visas to international students in 2025
description:
US Department of State data shows a dramatic -23% reduction in the number of new F-1, M-1, and J-1 student visas issued to international students in 2025 versus 2024. The drop was especially severe for the visa class associated with degree-seeking students: the F-1 visa, where issuances fell by a third in 2025 versus 2024.…
